name: recurring-buy-npm
description: The same checks for a project scaffolded with --package-manager npm. Point validators.commands at this file in such a project.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install workspace dependencies the way create-scaffold-hbar does.

commands.name: lint
commands.command: npm run next:lint -- --max-warnings=0 && if [ -d packages/hardhat ]; then npm run hardhat:lint -- --max-warnings=0; else npm run foundry:lint; fi
commands.purpose: Lint the app and the contracts package, Hardhat or Foundry, whichever the project has. ESLint allows zero warnings.

commands.name: build
commands.command: if [ -d packages/hardhat ]; then npm run hardhat:compile; else npm run foundry:compile; fi && npm run next:build
commands.purpose: Compile contracts and build the Next.js app (includes type checks).

commands.name: test
commands.command: if [ -d packages/hardhat ]; then npm run hardhat:test; else npm run foundry:test; fi
